content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

When Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad shut you down, your business is forced to operate in a gray area. The result is a costly, exhausting, and bureaucratic experience. You lose time, money, and control. Our infrastructure isn't a workaround. It's the foundation of a truly sovereign digital commerce stack. With Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you're not limited by the platforms you rely on. You're in control of your payment processing, order storage, and delivery pipeline.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy, you need a digital product to sell, a domain name, and a payment method. Your product can be an ebook, course, template, font, or any other digital item. You'll also need a domain name to host your store. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, so you can choose the one that best suits your business needs. The payment method you choose will be integrated with your website using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your website. You'll need to create a webhook to send payment notifications to your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will trigger the delivery of your product to the customer. You can use Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, ensuring that your customers receive their products instantly. With Supabase, you'll have a secure and scalable database to store your orders.
You have complete control over your payment processing and order storage with our sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live, you'll need to deploy your infrastructure and configure your website to use the NOWPayments API. You'll also need to configure your Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script to handle payment notifications. Once you've completed these steps, you can start selling your digital products. Your first transaction will be the start of a new era in your business – one where you're in control of your payment processing and order storage.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.

Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip? Yes, you can. With our sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can sell your digital products without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. Our solution uses NOWPayments for payment processing, Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and Supabase for order storage. You'll have complete control over your payment processing and order storage, eliminating the need for a platform like Gumroad.
Selling digital products without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip is now possible with our infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, our sovereign commerce infrastructure is the perfect solution. With NOWPayments, you can process payments in your preferred cryptocurrency, and with Cloudflare Pages, you can host your store without relying on a platform like Gumroad. You can also check out our Complete Builder Kit ($197) for instant access to all the resources you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore our products and find the perfect solution for your business.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: set up your domain name, create a payment method using NOWPayments, integrate NOWPayments with your website using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, configure your Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script to handle payment notifications, and deploy your infrastructure. Once you've completed these steps, you'll be ready to go live and start processing transactions.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my website?

To integrate NOWPayments with your website, you'll need to create a webhook to send payment notifications to your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will trigger the delivery of your product to the customer. You can use Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, ensuring that your customers receive their products instantly.
What happens if I encounter a payment issue?

If you encounter a payment issue, you can contact NOWPayments directly for support. They'll be able to assist you with any payment-related issues. Additionally, you can configure your Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script to handle payment notifications, ensuring that you're notified in case of a payment issue.
Can I use multiple payment methods?
Yes, you can use multiple payment methods with NOWPayments. You can choose to support multiple cryptocurrencies or payment methods, giving you the flexibility to cater to your customers' needs.
How do I configure my Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script to handle payment notifications?

To configure your Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script to handle payment notifications, you'll need to create a webhook to send payment notifications to your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will trigger the delivery of your product to the customer.
What is the cost of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on every sale. This is significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% charge, making it an attractive option for businesses looking to reduce their payment processing costs.
